explanation: The main character in the Book of Job, a righteous and wealthy man who experiences great trials and suffering.
An evil spiritual being who challenges God's authority and accuses Job of serving God only because of his blessings.
Challenges and difficulties that Job must endure to prove his faithfulness to God.
Material prosperity and resources that Job loses as part of his trials.
Job had ten children who died during his trials, which deepened his suffering.
The ability to endure hardships and adversity without losing faith or hope. Job shows great patience through his trials.
